    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    N = int(data[0])
    P = list(map(int, data[1:1 + N]))

    bit = [0] * (N + 2)

    def add(i):
        while i <= N:
            bit[i] += 1
            i += i & -i

    def prefix(i):
        s = 0
        while i > 0:
            s += bit[i]
            i -= i & -i
        return s

    ans = 0
    for v in P:
        smaller_before = prefix(v - 1) if v > 1 else 0
        cur = 1 + smaller_before
